idea: Tag every 0DTE session by which side of the CBOE zero-gamma-flip SPY closed on, using the archive Gamma_CboeOiBank already banks.
mechanism_1line: Dealer hedging flips from move-dampening (positive gamma) to move-amplifying (negative gamma) at the zero-gamma strike -- a regime tag no current filter reads.
data_source: journal/gex-archive/*-cboe.json (Gamma_CboeOiBank, free CBOE CDN, 14 sessions banked as of 2026-07-09) + gex_regime.py (already built).

idea: Read CBOE's VIX1D (1-day volatility index, ticker ^VIX1D) as a same-horizon vol gate instead of only the 30-day headline VIX.
mechanism_1line: VIX1D isolates ULTRA-short-dated (next-day/0DTE-horizon) implied vol -- a more precisely-dated 'is today expected to be calm or violent' gate than 30-day VIX (C5: VIX character > VIX level).
data_source: CBOE VIX1D index -- same access path Gamma already uses for VIX (Alpaca index endpoints or yfinance fallback).

idea: Add TradingView's Volume Profile (Visible Range) study and read its high-volume-node 'shelves' as a structural level source.
mechanism_1line: High-volume nodes mark where the market previously accepted price for extended time -- SPY/MES tend to pause, reject, or accelerate through them, independent of Gamma's own trendline/level-memory engines.
data_source: TradingView built-in Volume Profile (Visible Range) study via the existing TV MCP (chart_manage_indicator + data_get_pine_boxes/lines).

idea: Vet and add a published TradingView community support/resistance or auction-market-theory script as a second, independently-authored structure lens.
mechanism_1line: Convergence between an outside author's S/R read and Gamma's own level-memory/trendline read is a stronger structural signal than either alone.
data_source: TradingView public Pine Script community library (Scripts tab) -- requires manually selecting + adding a specific published script before its output is machine-readable.

idea: Ingest FINRA's daily short sale volume files for SPY as a crude aggressive-short-positioning proxy.
mechanism_1line: An elevated SPY short-volume ratio the prior session is a proxy for aggressive short positioning that can fuel a short-covering squeeze on any bullish trigger the next 0DTE session.
data_source: FINRA Daily Short Sale Volume Files (cts.finra.org) -- free, public, published T+1 per security, no auth; no ingestion pipeline exists yet.

idea: Track a DIX-style dark-pool short-volume ratio (SqueezeMetrics DIX concept) as a sentiment lens distinct from GEX/options positioning.

data_source: SqueezeMetrics DIX (squeezemetrics.com) or derived from FINRA ATS aggregate dark-pool volume -- CURRENT FREE AVAILABILITY UNVERIFIED, must confirm before treating as battery-ready.

idea: Adopt a formal pattern-labeling grammar (e.g. the Lo/Mamaysky/Wang nonparametric kernel-regression method for head-and-shoulders, double tops, etc.) as a shared vocabulary layered on top of Gamma's own HH/HL/LH/LL structure engine.

data_source: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang (2000) 'Foundations of Technical Analysis', Journal of Finance -- a research-methodology idea, not a data feed; needs engineering, not a new vendor.

idea: Read NYSE Market-on-Close imbalance indications (published from 15:50 ET) as a same-window final-hour drift predictor.
mechanism_1line: A large one-sided MOC imbalance often front-runs and extends the final-hour drift -- directly overlaps Gamma's own 15:50-15:55 ET flatten window, a same-window read, not a lagging one.
data_source: NYSE Closing Auction (MOC) Imbalance feed -- the raw real-time feed is an exchange data product (typically paid); free delayed summaries are sometimes relayed via financial news, unverified as a reliable source.

idea: Compute the overnight CME Globex session high/low/range for ES/NQ as pre-cash-open key levels for the MES swing mirror.

data_source: CME Globex overnight OHLC for ES/NQ, derivable from the SAME yfinance ES=F feed futures_mirror_shadow.py already polls -- needs a session-boundary rollup, not a new vendor.

idea: Ingest the weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders report for ES/NQ as a multi-day positioning-bias context filter for the MES swing mirror.

data_source: CFTC Commitments of Traders report (cftc.gov, free, weekly, published Fridays) -- no ingestion pipeline exists yet.

idea: Apply classic time-of-day seasonality analysis (opening range / lunch lull / power hour literature) to Gamma's OWN fill timestamps to see if entry hour predicts WR/expectancy.

idea: 0DTE Gamma Concentration Index – sum of gamma weighted by open interest at each strike normalized by total gamma
mechanism_1line: High gamma concentration near spot predicts increased intraday volatility and mean-reverting pressure as dealers hedge
data_source: CBOE options OI and implied volatility for SPY 0DTE strikes (free OI via CBOE FTP, free IV from CBOE VIX term structure); gamma computed via Black‑Scholes

idea: SPY 0DTE Max Pain – strike price at which total option dollar loss for holders is minimized for same‑is‑maximized for writers
mechanism_1line: Price tends to gravitate toward max pain at expiry as option writers hedge, providing intraday mean‑reversion signal
data_source: CBOE daily OI files for SPY options (free); max pain calculated for the 0DTE series, also available via free tiers of sites like MarketChameleon

idea: SPY Dark Pool Short Volume Ratio – proportion of short sales executed in dark pools relative to total volume
mechanism_1line: Elevated dark‑pool shorting often precedes downward pressure, offering a short‑term bearish edge for 0DTE options
data_source: FINRA Short Volume File (daily) for ticker SPY, freely downloadable from FINRA website; ratio = short volume / total volume

idea: Opening Range Breakout (ORB) predictive power for 0DTE SPY
mechanism_1line: The first 30‑minute price range often establishes the day's directional bias, and a breakout beyond that range predicts continuation with a measurable edge.
data_source: Intraday SPY minute bars from NYSE TAQ (or Polygon.io free tier)

idea: Intraday VWAP mean reversion
mechanism_1line: Price tends to revert to the volume‑weighted average price (VWAP) within the trading day, especially after deviations exceeding 0.5%, offering short‑term mean‑reversion opportunities.
data_source: Intraday SPY and MES minute VWAP calculated from TAQ or IQFeed data

idea: Turn‑of‑the‑month effect in equity index futures
mechanism_1line: Returns are systematically higher on the last trading day of a month and the first three days of the next month due to institutional cash flows, biasing intraday direction.
data_source: Daily MES/ES continuous contract prices from Quandl/CME DataMine (free sample)

idea: Overnight gap fill probability for SPY
mechanism_1line: When SPY opens with a gap >0.2% from the prior close, the price tends to fill that gap within the first 60 minutes about 65% of the time, providing a directional bias for 0DTE entries.
data_source: Intraday SPY minute bars plus daily close from Polygon.io (free)

idea: VIX term structure slope (VIX3M minus VIX1D) as a leading indicator of SPY 0DTE direction
mechanism_1line: A steep contango (positive slope) signals low near-term volatility expectations and often precedes bullish moves, while backwardation warns of impending volatility spikes and downside risk.
data_source: CBOE VIX1D index (^VIX1D) and VIX3M index (^VIX3M), freely available via most market data vendors (e.g., Yahoo Finance, Quandl CHRIS/CBOE_VX1 and VX3)

idea: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread (DGS10-DGS2) from FRED as a macro‑risk gauge for equity direction
mechanism_1line: Flattening or inversion of the spread reflects rising recession fears and tends to precede bearish equity moves, whereas steepening signals growth optimism and bullish bias.
data_source: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) series DGS10 and DGS2, accessible via the FRED API or Quandl

idea: Front‑month WTI crude oil price (CL=F) as a commodity‑linked leading indicator for equity indices
mechanism_1line: Sharp drops in oil prices reflect weakening global demand and inflation concerns, often coinciding with risk‑off equity moves; rallies suggest reflationary optimism and equity support.
data_source: CME WTI Crude Oil front‑month futures ticker CL=F (or CL1!), available free via Quandl (CHRIS/CME_CL1) or Yahoo Finance

idea: CFTC Commitment of Traders (COT) Large Speculator Net Position for E-mini S&P 500 (CME: ES)
mechanism_1line: Tracks the aggregate directional bias of the biggest speculators, revealing shifts before retail flow impacts the intraday swing mirror.
data_source: CFTC COT reports via Quandl (code: CFTC/ES), released weekly on Fridays

idea: CME Globex Overnight Session High/Low/Range for Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 (MNQ)
mechanism_1line: Captures the true overnight price discovery window, allowing the swing mirror to align entry bias with the most recent global sentiment.
data_source: CME DataMine API (endpoint: /v1/futures/quotes?product=MNQ&session=OVERNIGHT)

idea: Daily Futures Curve Basis between CME E-mini S&P 500 (ES) and CME Micro E-mini S&P 500 (MES)
mechanism_1line: The spread between ES and MES reflects funding pressure and liquidity imbalances that can predict short‑term directional moves in MES swing positions.
data_source: CME Group Market Data Feed (MDU) – real‑time futures quotes for ES and MES

idea: CME Open Interest Change Delta for Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 (MNQ) on a 15‑minute bar
mechanism_1line: Rapid increases in open interest signal aggressive new positioning and can be used as a leading indicator for breakout moves in the swing mirror.
data_source: CME Open Interest API (https://api.cmegroup.com/v1/openinterest?symbol=MNQ&interval=15m)

idea: Exchange Volume Profile Heatmap for MES (CME: MES) aggregated by price level each trading day
mechanism_1line: Identifies high‑volume nodes that act as support/resistance, improving the placement of swing mirror entry and exit zones.
data_source: Bookmap data feed for CME futures (subscription required, ticker MES)

idea: NYSE TICK – real-time count of NYSE stocks ticking up minus those ticking down
mechanism_1line: Extreme TICK readings often precede short-term reversals in SPY and equity index futures, offering a intraday sentiment gauge.
data_source: NYSE via Bloomberg TICK index (symbol ^TICK) or Refinitiv Real-Time TICK feed

idea: NYSE Advance-Decline Line (ADD) – cumulative net advancing issues
mechanism_1line: Divergence between ADD and price can signal weakening breadth, predictive of pullbacks in SPY and futures.
data_source: NYSE Advance-Decline data published on NYSE.com and available via Quandl dataset NYSE/AD_LINE

idea: TRIN/Arms Index – ratio of advancing/declining volume to advancing/declining issues
mechanism_1line: TRIN >1 indicates bearish volume pressure, often foreshadowing intraday downturns in SPY and futures.
data_source: Calculated from NYSE advancing/declining volume and issues data; available via TradingView TRIN indicator using NYSE data feed

idea: CME MES/MNQ order‑book imbalance (bid‑ask volume delta) – net aggressive buying vs selling pressure
mechanism_1line: Persistent delta imbalance predicts short‑term price moves in the micro‑e‑mini futures, useful for scalping.
data_source: CME DataMine Depth of Market (DOM) feed for MES and MNQ symbols

idea: FINRA Daily Short‑Sale Volume – total short‑sale shares reported for NYSE/Nasdaq stocks
mechanism_1line: Elevated short‑sale volume can signal heightened bearish sentiment, often leading to short‑term reversals in SPY and futures.
data_source: FINRA Short Sale Volume data (downloadable CSV from FINRA.org)

idea: FRED macroeconomic indicators (e.g., Initial Jobless Claims, ISM Manufacturing PMI) via the FRED API
mechanism_1line: Provides leading economic news that drives intraday SPY and futures volatility, allowing the model to anticipate macro‑shock moves.
data_source: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) API – https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/fred/

idea: Daily Treasury Yield Curve Rates from the U.S. Treasury
mechanism_1line: Changes in short‑end yields affect futures pricing and SPY option implied volatility, giving a leading rate‑sensitive signal.
data_source: U.S. Department of the Treasury – Daily Treasury Yield Curve Rates (https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve)

idea: CBOE VIX1D (intraday VIX) index
mechanism_1line: Captures intraday spikes in expected volatility that are especially predictive for 0DTE SPY option moves.
data_source: CBOE VIX1D index (ticker ^VIX1D) – available free via most market‑data vendors (e.g., Yahoo Finance, Alpha Vantage)

idea: Reddit WallStreetBets sentiment via Pushshift API
mechanism_1line: Aggregates retail‑trader chatter that often precedes short‑term price spikes in SPY and futures.
data_source: Pushshift API – https://pushshift.io

idea: Volume Profile Visible Range (VPVR) by TradingView
mechanism_1line: Shows where most volume traded within the visible chart range, highlighting high‑volume nodes that act as magnet support/resistance for 0DTE options and futures.
data_source: TradingView built‑in indicator 'Volume Profile Visible Range' (free)

idea: Market Profile (TPO) by Alex Grover
mechanism_1line: Plots time‑price opportunity distribution to reveal value area, point of control, and imbalance zones that expose auction‑market structure invisible to simple trendlines.
data_source: Public Pine Script library: 'Market Profile' by Alex Grover (https://www.tradingview.com/script/...)

idea: Cumulative Delta (Order Flow) by LuxAlgo
mechanism_1line: Tracks the running difference between buyer‑initiated and seller‑initiated volume to expose hidden buying/selling pressure that precedes price moves in short‑term instruments.
data_source: Community Pine Script: 'Cumulative Delta' by LuxAlgo (free version on TradingView)

idea: Harmonic Pattern Scanner (ABCD, Gartley, Butterfly) by ZigZagTrader
mechanism_1line: Automatically labels harmonic price patterns on the chart, providing high‑probability reversal zones that complement EMA/RSI signals for 0DTE and futures entries.
data_source: Public Pine Script: 'Harmonic Pattern Scanner' by ZigZagTrader (https://www.tradingview.com/script/...)

idea: SPY 0DTE Put/Call Ratio (PCR) from CBOE Options Tape
mechanism_1line: High PCR signals bearish pressure that often precedes rapid SPY moves, improving timing of gamma scalping entries.
data_source: CBOE Options Market Data Feed (OPRA) – real‑time put and call volume for SPY, accessible via Bloomberg API or directly from CBOE (https://www.cboe.com/trading-resources/market-data/)

idea: Dealer Net Gamma Exposure (DNG) derived from CBOE GEX but filtered for market‑maker IDs
mechanism_1line: Isolating dealer‑specific gamma reveals where professional liquidity providers are hedging, highlighting short‑term directional bias for 0DTE strikes.
data_source: CBOE GEX data + dealer identifier list from FINRA's Market Maker Directory (downloadable CSV), combined via custom script

idea: VIX1D Index (^VIX1D) intraday momentum
mechanism_1line: The 1‑day implied volatility index reacts faster than VIX to market stress, offering a leading signal for imminent SPY volatility spikes.
data_source: CBOE VIX1D index ticker ^VIX1D, available via most market‑data vendors (e.g., Interactive Brokers, Bloomberg, Refinitiv)

idea: SPY 0DTE Implied Volatility Skew Ratio (IVS) – 25Δ put IV / 25Δ call IV
mechanism_1line: A widening skew indicates demand for downside protection, often preceding sharp moves that 0DTE gamma traders can capture.
data_source: OptionMetrics IvyDB US or Bloomberg's IV surface API for SPY (retrieve 25‑delta put and call IVs)

idea: Dark‑Pool Short‑Sale Volume Ratio (DIX‑SPY) from FINRA's Alternative Trading System data
mechanism_1line: Elevated short volume in dark pools signals aggressive bearish positioning that can trigger rapid SPY price drops, useful for timing gamma exposure adjustments.
data_source: FINRA ATS Trade Reporting (ATS‑TR) data feed, accessed via Quandl (code FINRA/ATS) or directly from FINRA's website

idea: Opening Range Breakout (ORB) effect – price moves beyond the first 30‑minute high/low tend to continue in that direction
mechanism_1line: Exploits early‑session momentum where traders react to order‑flow imbalances, giving a directional edge for 0DTE SPY options and MES futures
data_source: NYSE TAQ intraday data via WRDS (https://wrds-web.wharton.upenn.edu)

idea: VWAP Mean‑Reversion anomaly – intraday prices revert toward the VWAP after deviating beyond 1‑σ for 10‑15 minutes
mechanism_1line: Targets the pull‑back to the volume‑weighted average price caused by liquidity providers correcting mispricings, useful for short‑duration scalping in 0DTE options
data_source: NASDAQ ITCH Level‑2 feed (via Polygon.io API)

idea: Turn‑of‑Month (TOM) drift – systematic positive drift in equity index futures and SPY during the last trading day of the month and the first two days of the next month
mechanism_1line: Captures calendar‑based buying pressure from fund inflows and rebalancing, offering a bias for MES/MNQ futures and SPY options
data_source: CME Group historical futures data (https://www.cmegroup.com/market-data)

idea: Overnight Gap‑Fill statistic – stocks and index futures tend to close the overnight price gap within the first 30 minutes of the next session
mechanism_1line: Leverages the tendency of market participants to arbitrage away open‑to‑close gaps, providing a high‑probability entry for 0DTE SPY options and MES contracts
data_source: CRSP daily and intraday data via WRDS (https://wrds-web.wharton.upenn.edu)

idea: VIX term structure (VIX1D vs VIX30) contango/backwardation as intraday predictor of SPY 0DTE direction
mechanism_1line: When the 1‑day VIX is lower than the 30‑day VIX (backwardation), near‑term volatility is expected to drop, biasing SPY 0DTE bullish; the opposite contango signals bearish bias.
data_source: CBOE VIX1D (^VIX1D) and VIX30 (^VIX) indices, available free via most market‑data vendors (e.g., Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, CBOE API)

idea: 10Y‑2Y Treasury yield spread moves as a leading indicator for equity index futures direction
mechanism_1line: A steepening 10Y‑2Y spread reflects growth/inflation expectations and tends to precede bullish moves in SPY 0DTE and MES/MNQ futures; flattening or inversion precedes bearish moves.
data_source: FRED series GS10 (10‑year) and GS2 (2‑year) yields, downloadable via FRED API, Quandl, or Bloomberg

idea: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS (credit spread) as a risk‑sentiment gauge for equity index futures
mechanism_1line: Widening high‑yield OAS (>10 bps intraday) signals rising credit risk and tends to precede bearish moves in SPY 0DTE and MES/MNQ; tightening spreads signal bullish bias.
data_source: ICE BofA US High Yield Index OAS (FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2), accessible free via FRED API, Bloomberg, or Quandl

idea: CFTC COT large-speculator net positioning for E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures
mechanism_1line: Extreme net long/short positions often precede mean-reverting swings in the front-month contract, providing a contrarian signal for intraday/short-term moves.
data_source: CFTC Commitments of Traders weekly report, free download at https://www.cftc.gov/MarketReports/CommitmentsofTraders/index.htm

idea: CME Globex overnight session high-low range for E-mini Nasdaq-100 (MNQ) futures
mechanism_1line: A wide overnight range indicates heightened volatility and often predicts the magnitude of the next regular-session swing, useful for setting stop/profit targets.
data_source: CME DataMine historical intraday tick data for MNQ (Globex session)

idea: Front-month to second-month basis (curve) of E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures
mechanism_1line: Changes in the ES basis reflect near-term supply/demand imbalances and can lead price action in the front month, offering a leading indicator for swing moves.
data_source: Quandl EOD futures chain for CME_ES1 and CME_ES2 (free via https://www.quandl.com/data/CME)

idea: CME volume-at-price (volume profile) for E-mini Nasdaq-100 (MNQ) futures during RTH
mechanism_1line: High-volume nodes act as magnet/support-resistance levels; price reverting to these nodes provides high-probability swing entry/exit points.
data_source: CME Depth of Market (DOM) and time‑sales data via CME DataMine (or IQFeed) for MNQ

idea: CME Order Imbalance Indicator (OIB) for CME Globex futures
mechanism_1line: Identifies early buying or selling pressure from order imbalances before the CME auction, giving a predictive edge on MES/MNQ direction.
data_source: CME Group website – OIB data via CME Data API (free tier) https://www.cmegroup.com/tools-information.html

idea: U.S. Treasury Daily Yield Curve rates (e.g., 2‑yr, 10‑yr) from FRED
mechanism_1line: Rapid shifts in short‑term Treasury yields influence equity risk sentiment and can forecast intraday SPY moves.
data_source: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) series DGS2, DGS10 via https://fred.stlouisfed.org/

idea: IEX Cloud free tier real‑time trades and depth for SPY
mechanism_1line: Provides granular order‑book and trade‑by‑trade data to detect micro‑structure imbalances that precede short‑term price moves.
data_source: IEX Cloud API (free tier) https://iexcloud.io/docs/api/

idea: Polygon.io free options‑flow aggregation for SPY
mechanism_1line: Aggregates retail and institutional SPY options trades, highlighting unusually large blocks that often precede 0DTE price swings.
data_source: Polygon.io Options Trades endpoint (free tier) https://polygon.io/docs/options/get_v3_trades_options

idea: CBOE VIX1D Index (^VIX1D) via free market data
mechanism_1line: Tracks one‑day implied volatility spikes, a leading indicator of heightened market stress that can drive intraday SPY and futures volatility.
data_source: Yahoo Finance ticker ^VIX1D or any free market‑data provider offering the index
